name: China Aerospace Science and Technology Corporation (CASC) 8th Academy
aliases: 8th Research Academy of China Aerospace Science and Technology Corporation
supervisors: China Aerospace Science and Technology Corporation (CASC)

evidence.summary: CASC lists the Shanghai Academy of Spaceflight Technology (上海航天技术研究院) among its eight research academies, and the US Entity List names it as CASC’s 8th Academy; the list has named it since May 1999, under its current name since a 2019 revision. CASC is one of the state-owned defence-industry groups that SASTIND lists, and says it researches, designs, builds and tests strategic and tactical missiles as well as launch vehicles and spacecraft.
It belongs to CASC, which describes itself as a very large state-owned enterprise and a cornerstone of China’s national security strategy.
